title: Quantitative homogenization of the maximal action of curves in a Brownian potential
summary: Motivated by an optimal-matching problem (Leighton-Shor) and the random-field Ising model (Aizenman-Wehr, Ding-Wirth), we consider a variational problem for graphs in $1+1$ dimension maximizing an action that is the difference of a field term given by integrating white noise over the subgraph on the one hand, and the Dirichlet integral of the (continuum) height function $h=h(x)$ on the other hand. This problem is scale-invariant in law, and requires a small-scale cut-off which we implement by restricting to $h$ that are piecewise linear on intervals of size $1$ and vanish at $x=0,L$. We show…
